Container.Name: TickerGlass
Container.Overview: Self-hosted charting and market workstation: multi-chart layouts, drawings, 100+ indicators, scripting, server-side alerts (Telegram, ntfy, Gotify, email, webhooks), watchlists, screener, portfolio and backtests. Runs on your server, keeps your data in appdata, and works without an account. Needs about 1.5 GB of RAM because alerts can run scripts. Leave the password empty to run open on a trusted LAN, or set one before exposing it.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port of the web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: SQLite database, cached market data and the generated alerts token.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional login password. Empty = no login (only on a trusted network).

Config.Name: Market data provider
Config.Description: Where prices come from: yahoo (no key), twelvedata, alpaca, tiingo, massive or stooq (each needs its own API key variables, see docs/providers.md), crypto (exchange feed, no key) or demo (offline sample data).

Config.Name: Twelve Data API key
Config.Description: Only for MARKET_PROVIDER=twelvedata.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: External address (https://tickerglass.example.com) when behind a reverse proxy. Needed for OIDC sign-in and links in notifications.

Config.Name: User ID (PUID)
Config.Description: User the app runs as. 99 = nobody (Unraid default).

Config.Name: Group ID (PGID)
Config.Description: Group the app runs as. 100 = users (Unraid default).

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

Config.Name: Alerts token
Config.Description: Shared secret between the API and the alerts service. Empty = generated once and kept in appdata (.alerts_token).

Config.Name: Telegram bot token
Config.Description: Alert notifications through Telegram.

Config.Name: Telegram chat ID
Config.Description: Chat that receives Telegram alert notifications.

Config.Name: ntfy URL
Config.Description: ntfy topic URL, e.g. https://ntfy.sh/my-topic.

Config.Name: ntfy token
Config.Description: Access token for a protected ntfy topic.

Config.Name: Gotify URL
Config.Description: Gotify server URL.

Config.Name: Gotify token
Config.Description: Gotify application token.

Config.Name: Apprise URLs
Config.Description: Comma separated apprise:// URLs.

Config.Name: Webhook URL
Config.Description: Generic webhook for alert notifications.

Config.Name: Webhook secret
Config.Description: Signs webhook payloads (HMAC).

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Email alerts: SMTP server. See docs/alerts.md for the other SMTP_* variables.

Config.Name: Backup folder
Config.Description: Scheduled nightly backups of the whole database: a folder inside the container, e.g. /data/backups (appdata, same disk) or a path you added for a share on another disk. Empty = no local backups. Restore in Settings > Server.

Config.Name: Backup time
Config.Description: Daily backup time (HH:MM, 24 hours) in BACKUP_TZ (default UTC).

Config.Name: Backup passphrase
Config.Description: Encrypts every backup (12+ characters). If you lose it the backups cannot be read.

Config.Name: Backup S3 endpoint
Config.Description: S3-compatible store for backups (AWS S3, MinIO, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, R2), e.g. http://192.168.1.10:9000. Needs the bucket and both keys below.

Config.Name: Backup S3 bucket
Config.Description: Bucket that receives the backups.

Config.Name: Backup S3 access key ID
Config.Description: Access key ID of the backup bucket.

Config.Name: Backup S3 secret key
Config.Description: Secret access key of the backup bucket.

Config.Name: Backup S3 region
Config.Description: Region of the bucket (MinIO: leave the default).

Config.Name: Metrics enabled
Config.Description: true serves Prometheus metrics at /metrics on the web port (see docs/metrics.md). Set Metrics token as well when sign-in is on.

Config.Name: Metrics token
Config.Description: Bearer token (16+ characters) Prometheus sends to /metrics. Needed when METRICS_ENABLED is true and sign-in is on.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Ask AI about the chart: address of an Ollama server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434 (start Ollama with OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0). Empty means off. See docs/ai.md.

Config.Name: OIDC issuer
Config.Description: Single sign-on (Authentik, Authelia, Keycloak, Pocket ID): issuer URL. Needs PUBLIC_URL.

Config.Name: OIDC client ID
Config.Description: Client ID registered at the identity provider.

Config.Name: OIDC client secret
Config.Description: Client secret registered at the identity provider.
